review_evidence: README identifies a Lean implementation of Ethereum consensus specifications with executable fork/state-transition code and an SSZ verified core.
The hydrated monorepo contains formal SSZ specifications, Ethereum consensus structures, pure SHA-256/Poseidon definitions, and proof packages including field/hash correctness statements.
These interfaces, executable specifications, axioms and theorems are direct prior-art material even where some packages bridge to FFI implementations.
summary: Reviewed etheorem; retain its Ethereum consensus specifications, SSZ formalization, cryptographic reference models, and proof packages.
